crossRefs.note: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

translations.web: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
translations.bsb: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.
translations.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet
translations.asv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.
